scope: Current official Google requirements relevant to a future iLoveTimers AdSense application. This is a repository-readiness assessment, not legal advice or an approval prediction.

sources.requirementSupported: Publishers must avoid invalid clicks or impressions, prohibited click encouragement, deceptive ad formatting, and inappropriate placements.
repositoryEvidence: app/clients/config/monetization.ts permits quiet placeholders only on the homepage and declares all other reviewed route classes ad-free.
app/clients/components/ui/foundation.tsx labels placeholders only as Advertisements.
No Google ad script or live ad-unit implementation exists in application source.
sources.result: pass for the current advertising-disabled repository state
sources.actionTaken: Kept live advertising disabled and included placement and prohibited-language checks in the final gate.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: A future production ad configuration must be reviewed again after the owner selects units or Auto ads.

sources.requirementSupported: Ads must not invite accidental clicks, receive unnatural attention, resemble navigation or content, or use misleading labels; Advertisements and Sponsored Links are permitted labels.
repositoryEvidence: The two homepage placeholders are separated from navigation and active tool controls.
No placeholder is sticky, animated, adjacent to Start/Stop/Reset, or present on tool routes.
sources.result: pass for placeholders; future live placements are not approved by this evidence
sources.actionTaken: Preserved the restrained homepage-only layout and added placement assertions to automated release checks.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Recheck rendered mobile and desktop placement after any live ad code is proposed.

sources.requirementSupported: Advertising should not obstruct the user's task, should remain distinguishable as advertising, and should preserve clean navigation and content access.
repositoryEvidence: Tool pages remain ad-free and utility-first.
The homepage remains usable if placeholders never load live content.
Placeholder dimensions are responsive and reserve layout space.
sources.actionTaken: Measured homepage layout shift and responsive behavior in the final browser suite.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Real ad creative behavior cannot be validated before account and unit configuration exist.

sources.requirementSupported: Monetized content must comply with Google's content, behavioral, privacy, and other publisher requirements.
repositoryEvidence: The final route, content, trust, structured-data, privacy, link, and safety-claim reviews cover the complete canonical route set.
No fake reviews, ratings, organization details, medical authority, or official time-source claims are present in the validated output.
sources.result: repository review passed within documented automation and manual-sampling limits
sources.actionTaken: Re-ran route-family content and policy-sensitive claim audits rather than relying only on prior reports.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Google performs the final site review and may apply policies or restrictions not reproducible locally.

sources.requirementSupported: When Google publisher products are used, the privacy policy must disclose relevant third-party data collection, sharing, identifiers, cookies, web beacons, and IP-address use.
repositoryEvidence: The current Privacy and Cookie pages accurately say live advertising and advertising cookies are absent.
They separately disclose consent-gated PostHog behavior, local storage, share URLs, coordinates, and the Sunrise-Sunset API.
sources.result: pass for current behavior; future-advertising disclosure remains an external gate
sources.actionTaken: Did not add speculative Google-advertising claims while advertising is disabled.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Update disclosures and provide required choices only after the owner selects and configures the actual advertising and consent setup.

sources.pageTitle: Google consent management requirements for serving ads in the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland (for CMPs)
sources.requirementSupported: Serving personalized ads in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland requires a Google-certified CMP integrated with the IAB TCF; publisher consent responsibilities remain applicable.
repositoryEvidence: No live ad request is made and no CMP is installed or claimed.
Analytics remains independently opt-in and unavailable when no VITE_POSTHOG_KEY is configured.
sources.result: not applicable while advertising is disabled; required future external gate
sources.actionTaken: Left CMP selection and configuration untouched as requested.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Owner choice plus AdSense/CMP account access, regional configuration, and production verification.

sources.requirementSupported: The root ads.txt record should use the authorized seller format and the publisher ID associated with the AdSense account; deployed status must be checked from the account.
repositoryEvidence: public/ads.txt contains one syntactically valid DIRECT record: google.com, pub-4810616735714570, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0.
The production build copies the file to /ads.txt as text/plain-compatible static content.
sources.result: format passes; account ownership and deployed authorization are unverified
sources.actionTaken: Did not replace, invent, or remove the existing publisher ID.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: Owner must confirm pub-4810616735714570 belongs to the intended AdSense account; after deployment verify https://www.ilovetimers.com/ads.txt and the AdSense ads.txt status.

sources.requirementSupported: Google verifies site ownership and reviews a site; ads may be served only after the site has passed review and has Ready status.
repositoryEvidence: The repository identifies the production origin consistently and includes a real-looking ads.txt record, but it contains no verifiable AdSense account state.
No site-verification meta tag or live AdSense script was invented.
sources.actionTaken: Recorded the gate without presenting repository readiness as Google approval.
sources.ownerOrExternalDependency: AdSense account access, site ownership verification, application submission, and Google's review.
